description:
the solstone app for windows

the solstone app for windows takes in what you share with it from your screen, system audio, and any microphone you choose. it prepares local, owner-controlled segments for your journal. the solstone app runs on windows; your journal lives on a computer you own. no telemetry.
Fixed
- browser pages still waiting on this PC now stay here when you unpair. after you pair with a journal and confirm its mark, they go to that journal.
- a segment a journal turns away is now held back from that journal only. once you pair with a different journal and confirm its mark, the segment goes to the new journal.
